annotations.title: List a record's notes, tasks or events

description: List the Notes, Tasks or Events attached to one Contact, Organisation, Lead, Opportunity or Project — the activity history of that record. Insightly: GET /<Object>/{id}/Notes | Tasks | Events.

brief.description: true = only top-level fields (no CUSTOMFIELDS, TAGS, LINKS, ...). Smaller and faster.

count_total.description: true = also return the total number of matching records (response becomes {total_count, items}).

updated_after_utc.description: Only items updated after this time, yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ.
